name: Featured Image Customizer for WordPress – Custom Featured Images with Brand Logos Generator
author: Krasen Slavov

sections.description:
Generate custom featured images instantly with Featured Image Customizer – the WordPress featured image generator that creates professional post thumbnails with 100+ brand logos in seconds.

Stop using generic stock photos or designing featured images in external tools. Featured Image Customizer generates custom featured images directly in WordPress with popular brand logos, customizable backgrounds, and professional layouts. Create eye-catching post thumbnails for comparison posts, tutorials, reviews, and social media sharing without leaving your WordPress editor.

Whether you’re writing tech comparisons, product reviews, or tutorial content, Featured Image Customizer makes WordPress featured image creation fast and visual.

Why Choose Featured Image Customizer?

  • WordPress Featured Image Generator – Create custom images in seconds
  • 100+ Brand Logos – Social media, tech companies, productivity tools
  • No Design Skills – Generate featured images without Photoshop
  • Gutenberg Compatible – Works in Block Editor and Classic Editor
  • Auto Thumbnails – WordPress thumbnail sizes generated automatically
  • Media Library – All images saved for reuse in WordPress

How WordPress Featured Image Generator Works

  1. Install and activate Featured Image Customizer on your WordPress site
  2. Edit any post or page in WordPress editor
  3. Click New Featured Image button in featured image area
  4. Select two brand logos from 100+ options
  5. Choose conjunction word (vs, and, +) and background color
  6. Click generate – custom featured image created instantly
  7. Image sets automatically as WordPress post thumbnail

Zero configuration required – works immediately with WordPress posts and pages.

Perfect For

  • Tech Bloggers creating comparison post thumbnails
  • Review Sites generating product comparison images
  • Tutorial Writers making how-to article featured images
  • Social Media Managers creating shareable post thumbnails
  • Marketing Teams designing blog post featured images
  • Content Creators building visual WordPress content

WordPress Featured Image Features

Custom Featured Image Generator
Create WordPress featured images instantly with brand logo combinations. Select two logos, add conjunction text, choose background color, and generate professional post thumbnails in seconds. All images created at 800x600px with proper WordPress thumbnail generation.

100+ Brand Logo Library
Access extensive collection of popular brand logos including social media platforms (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram), tech companies (Google, Apple, Microsoft), productivity tools, and more. Brand logos load from API with local caching for bandwidth savings.

WordPress Thumbnail Generator
Generate WordPress post thumbnails with all standard thumbnail sizes automatically. Custom featured images include full-size and thumbnail versions, properly optimized for WordPress themes and social media sharing.

Block Editor Featured Image
Native WordPress Gutenberg integration with New Featured Image button directly in Block Editor. Create custom featured images without leaving Gutenberg. Same functionality available in WordPress Classic Editor.

Featured Image Customization
Customize WordPress featured images with multiple background colors, logo combinations, and conjunction words. Preview custom images before setting as post thumbnail. All featured image customization happens visually in WordPress editor.

Media Library Integration
All generated featured images save to WordPress Media Library following WordPress standards. Reuse custom images across multiple posts. Delete or replace featured images anytime through standard WordPress media management.

Usage

Once the WordPress featured image generator is installed and activated:

  1. Edit any post or page in WordPress editor
  2. Scroll to Featured Image section in sidebar
  3. Click New Featured Image button
  4. Select first brand logo from 100+ options
  5. Choose conjunction word (vs, and, with, +, etc.)
  6. Select second brand logo
  7. Pick background color
  8. Preview custom featured image
  9. Click Generate to create WordPress post thumbnail
  10. Featured image sets automatically

Here are the steps to use Featured Image Customizer:

  1. Open Editor – Edit WordPress post or page
  2. Click Button – Find New Featured Image in sidebar
  3. Select Logos – Choose 2 brand logos from library
  4. Customize – Pick conjunction word and background color
  5. Generate – Create custom WordPress featured image
  6. Publish – Post thumbnail now displays on WordPress site

Note: Custom post types and advanced layouts available in future versions.

WordPress Featured Image Settings

Post Type Settings:
1. Go to Settings > Media in WordPress admin
2. Find Featured Image Customizer section
3. Enable/disable for WordPress Posts
4. Enable/disable for WordPress Pages
5. Save settings

Logo Cache Management:
1. Access Settings > Media
2. Find Clear Logo Cache button
3. Click to delete locally cached brand logos
4. Previously generated featured images remain unchanged

Generating Custom Images:
1. Open WordPress post in editor
2. Featured Image metabox shows in sidebar
3. Click New Featured Image button
4. Modal opens with brand logo library
5. Select first logo from 100+ brands
6. Choose conjunction: vs, and, with, +, or custom
7. Select second brand logo
8. Choose background color from palette
9. Preview shows custom featured image
10. Click Generate to create WordPress thumbnail

Supported WordPress Content:
– Posts
– Pages
– Standard WordPress featured images
– All WordPress thumbnail sizes

Features & Limitations

The Featured Image Customizer WordPress featured image generator allows you to:

  • Generate custom featured images in WordPress instantly
  • Create WordPress post thumbnails with 100+ brand logos
  • Add featured images to WordPress posts and pages
  • Use featured image generator in Block Editor and Classic Editor
  • Customize background colors for WordPress thumbnails
  • Choose conjunction words for logo combinations
  • Save generated images to WordPress Media Library
  • Generate all WordPress thumbnail sizes automatically
  • Preview custom featured images before generating
  • Cache brand logos locally for WordPress performance
  • Clear logo cache without affecting featured images
  • Access 100+ popular brand logos for thumbnails

WordPress Featured Image Components

Brand Logo Library
Extensive collection of 100+ popular brand logos including social media (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn), tech companies (Google, Apple, Microsoft, Amazon), productivity tools, and more. Logos load via API with local caching to save WordPress bandwidth.

Featured Image Modal
Visual WordPress interface for creating custom featured images. Select brand logos from organized library, choose conjunction words, pick background colors, and preview before generating. Modal integrates seamlessly with WordPress editor.

Thumbnail Generator
Automatic WordPress thumbnail generation creates all standard thumbnail sizes. Featured images include full-size (800x600px) and WordPress theme thumbnail sizes. All images optimized for WordPress and social media sharing.

Media Library Integration
Generated featured images save to WordPress Media Library with proper metadata. Reuse custom images across WordPress posts. Delete, edit, or replace featured images through standard WordPress media management.

WordPress Editor Integration
New Featured Image button appears in WordPress featured image metabox for both Gutenberg Block Editor and Classic Editor. Create custom featured images without leaving WordPress post editor.

Background Customization
Multiple background color options for WordPress featured images. Match brand colors, theme styling, or content topics. Preview background colors before generating custom featured images.

Known Limitations

Current version features:

  • Post Types – Posts and Pages only (Custom post types in future)
  • Layouts – Logo + conjunction + logo only (More layouts coming)
  • Logo Count – 100+ brands (Continuously adding more)
  • Image Size – 800x600px standard (Custom sizes in future)
  • WooCommerce – Not supported yet (Integration planned)
  • Custom Logos – Not available (Feature under consideration)
  • Batch Generation – Single images only (Bulk feature planned)
  • Advanced Options – Basic customization (Enhanced options coming)

Detailed Documentation

Find step-by-step setup guides, video tutorials, WordPress featured image tips, and brand logo lists on the Featured Image Customizer Documentation page.
sections.installation:
Installing the WordPress featured image generator is straightforward. Contact support if you encounter any issues.

Requirements:
– WordPress 5.0 or higher
– PHP 7.2 or higher
– Gutenberg Block Editor or Classic Editor

Installation from WordPress

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for Featured Image Customizer
  3. Click Install Now then Activate
  4. Edit any post to access featured image generator

Manual Installation

  1. Download the WordPress featured image plugin ZIP file
  2. Upload the featured-image-customizer folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Go to Plugins in WordPress admin
  4. Activate Featured Image Customizer
  5. Edit any post to generate custom featured images

After Activation

  1. Edit any WordPress post or page
  2. Find Featured Image section in editor sidebar
  3. Click New Featured Image button
  4. Modal opens with brand logo library
  5. Select two brand logos from 100+ options
  6. Choose conjunction word (vs, and, with, +)
  7. Pick background color
  8. Preview custom featured image
  9. Click Generate button
  10. WordPress post thumbnail is set automatically!

Quick Start:
1. Edit WordPress post
2. Click New Featured Image
3. Select 2 brand logos
4. Choose color and conjunction
5. Generate custom thumbnail!
sections.faq:
Visit the Support Forum to share your questions or requests.

We usually respond to tickets within 24 hours.

Feature requests are added to our wish list and considered for future updates.

How do I create custom featured images in WordPress?

Edit any WordPress post, click New Featured Image in the featured image sidebar, select two brand logos, choose conjunction word and background color, and click Generate. The custom featured image sets automatically as your WordPress post thumbnail.

What’s the best WordPress featured image generator?

Featured Image Customizer provides instant custom featured image generation for WordPress. 100+ brand logos, no design skills required, Gutenberg integration, and automatic WordPress thumbnail generation make it ideal for creating post thumbnails quickly.

How to add brand logos to WordPress featured images?

Install Featured Image Customizer, edit any post, click New Featured Image button, select brand logos from the 100+ available options, and generate. Your custom WordPress featured image includes the selected brand logos automatically.

Does this work with Gutenberg Block Editor?

Yes, Featured Image Customizer works perfectly with WordPress Gutenberg. The New Featured Image button appears in the Block Editor featured image panel with full functionality for generating custom WordPress post thumbnails.

Can I use this with Classic Editor?

Yes, full WordPress Classic Editor support is included. The New Featured Image button appears in the featured image metabox when editing posts in Classic Editor with identical featured image generation functionality.

How many brand logos are available?

Featured Image Customizer includes 100+ popular brand logos including social media platforms, tech companies, productivity tools, and more. We continuously add new brand logos based on user requests.

Will generated images appear in Media Library?

Yes, all custom featured images are saved to WordPress Media Library with proper thumbnails. Generated images follow WordPress standards and can be reused across multiple posts or pages.

Can I customize the background color?

Yes, Featured Image Customizer offers multiple background color options for WordPress featured images. Choose colors that match your brand, theme, or content topic when generating custom post thumbnails.

Does this slow down my WordPress site?

No, Featured Image Customizer is optimized for WordPress performance. Brand logos cache locally to save bandwidth. Featured image generation happens on-demand only when you create custom images.

What image size are featured images generated at?

Custom featured images are generated at 800x600px, a standard WordPress featured image size. All WordPress thumbnail sizes are automatically generated ensuring compatibility with themes and plugins.

Can I use custom logos or upload my own?

Custom logo upload is not available in the current version. Featured Image Customizer uses 100+ pre-loaded brand logos. Custom logo support is under consideration for future WordPress featured image generator updates.

Does this work with WordPress Multisite?

Yes, Featured Image Customizer is fully tested and compatible with WordPress multisite installations. Generate custom featured images across all sites in your WordPress network.

Can I create featured images for WooCommerce products?

WooCommerce product support is planned for future releases. Currently, Featured Image Customizer works with WordPress Posts and Pages only for custom featured image generation.

How to request new brand logos?

Contact us through the Krasen Slavov website to request specific brand logos. We continuously expand our WordPress featured image generator logo library based on user needs.

Can I batch generate featured images?

Batch generation is not currently available. Featured images are created individually per post. Bulk WordPress featured image generation is planned for future versions.

Are generated featured images SEO optimized?

Yes, generated featured images follow WordPress best practices with proper file naming, thumbnail generation, and metadata. Custom featured images work perfectly for SEO and social media sharing.
